notes: εἰσῆλθεν εἰς writes one English particle for the preverb and the expressed preposition, so it belongs to the preposition and the verb keeps only came (rule 106, following εἰσελθὼν εἰς → entered / into). Contrast MAT.2.6, where the ASV writes forth in addition to a complete out of.
The variant unit SBLGNT.MAT.2.21.v009 is underdetermined over s012 and no textual decision is taken here (rule 12).
